summary.text: Kristin Marcell is a Republican state representative who has represented Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 178 since December 2022 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
She previously served on the Council Rock School District board.

paragraphs.text: Kristin Marcell was born in Doylestown Township, Pennsylvania, and lives in Wrightstown, Pennsylvania.

She graduated from Council Rock High School in 1995, earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Pennsylvania State University in 1999, and received a master's degree in public policy from George Washington University in 2006.

Her career experience includes working as the communications director of the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration under former President George W. Bush, and she has served as vice chair of the Middle Bucks Institute of Technology's Executive Council.
Marcell succeeded Republican Wendi Thomas in the House.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Aging and Older Adult Services, Appropriations and Professional Licensure committees, serving as secretary of the last.
